ai.sh: Used to determine whether The SMS Works AI Optimiser should be used in the event that the message is just longer than the 1 or 2 credit boundary.

content.sh: Message to send to the recipient

deliveryreporturl.sh: The url to which we should POST delivery reports to for this message.

destinations.sh: Telephone numbers of each of the recipients

schedule.sh: Date-time at which to send the batch.

tag.sh: An identifying label for the message, which you can use to filter and report on messages you've sent later.

ttl.sh: The number of minutes before the delivery report is deleted.

validity.sh: The optional number of minutes to attempt delivery before the message is marked as EXPIRED.

credits.sh: The number of credits used on the message.

destination.sh: The phone number of the recipient.

from.sh: The date-time from which you would like matching messages

keyword.sh: The keyword used in the inbound message

limit.sh: The maximum number of messages that you would like returned in this call.

metadata.sh: An array of objects containing metadata key/value pairs that have been saved on messages.

sender.sh: The sender of the message (this can be the configured sender name for an outbound message or the senders phone number for an inbound message).

skip.sh: The number of results you would like to ignore before returning messages.

status.sh: The status of the messages you would like returned (either 'SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'EXPIRED', 'UNDELIVERABLE', 'REJECTED' or 'INCOMING')

to.sh: The date-time to which you would like matching messages

unread.sh: In queries for incoming messages ('status' is 'INCOMING'), specify whether you explicitly want unread messages (true) or read messages (false).

destination.sh: The phone number of the recipient.

length.sh: The length of the generated passcode.

metadata.sh: A JSON object of no longer than 1024 bytes, containing as many parameters as you wish, to store data for use in your application.

passcode.sh: A passcode you supply for use in the message template.

template.sh: A template to use as the content for the message.

validity.sh: The length of time in seconds for which the generated passcode should be valid.
